items.title: The debate on GHG Protocol’s electricity accounting revisions is far from over
items.summary: A workshop held in late October by the Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol to debate revisions to its widely used electricity standards failed to resolve multiple questions key to the future of corporate renewable strategies, including how to transition to the new rules and how long existing contracts will be recognized.

items.title: AI tools that work — and tips from the sustainability leaders who built them
items.summary: Guidance on AI for sustainability professionals can turn impractical quickly.

items.title: Updated: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: Updated: Sustainability tools to use in 2026
items.summary: Welcome to the Trellis roundup of new products and services for sustainability professionals, as chosen by our editorial team.

items.title: Climate data still side-lined in major business decisions, research finds
items.summary: New Ordnance Survey (OS) research has found that climate data remains side-lined in 67% of major strategic or investment decisions, representing a sizeable blind spot in corporate planning.

items.title: Burnham names UK climate security envoy at COP31
items.summary: During his appearance in Antalya, the Prime Minister named Dame Madeleine Alessandri, a former national security adviser, as the UK's new climate security envoy.

items.title: COP31 Covered podcast: Cities, climate risk and the outgoing Climate Champion
items.summary: The fourth episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with COP30 Climate High-Level Champion Dan Ioschpe.

items.title: From Burnham’s COP31 debut to a new ‘resilient cities’ pledge: What happened on 12 November at COP31?
items.summary: Today marked the fourth day of COP31 and the second and final day of the Leaders Summit, with discussions centred on the theme of Resilient Cities.

items.title: ONE WEEK TO REGISTER: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: Leading oil and gas companies set methane standards many European suppliers have yet to meet, IEA finds
items.summary: A small group of oil and gas companies are disclosing more information about methane emissions and setting out clearer plans to address them, but the gap between these companies and much of the industry remains wide.
